description: Figure: PP_1451 residues at every experimentally tested DpaA catalytic and substrate-binding position, with structural deviation after superposition
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ============ FIGURE: catalytic-site and specificity mapping, PP_1451 vs characterised DpaA ============
rows=[
 ("K83",  "K82",  "L1: salt bridge to mDAP D-centre COOH", 0.0,  "retained"),
 ("Q86",  "E85",  "L1: mDAP D-centre COOH",                62.0, "conservative"),
 ("R108", "R105", "L2: packs Lpp L-Lys side chain",        41.0, "retained"),
 ("Y109", "F106", "L2: packs Lpp L-Lys side chain",        0.7,  "conservative (aromatic)"),
 ("K130", "S132", "L3: binding cleft",                     64.0, "not retained"),
 ("Y131", "M133", "L3: packs Lpp L-Lys side chain",        4.0,  "not retained"),
 ("H135", "H137", "PROSITE proton donor/acceptor",         np.nan,"retained"),
 ("C143", "C159", "catalytic nucleophile",                 np.nan,"retained"),
 ("A145", "A161", "Cys+2: Ala in DpaA, Arg in LD-TPases",  np.nan,"retained"),
]
dev=[0.91,1.43,2.78,2.09,1.52,1.46,1.04,0.97,0.95]
colmap={"retained":"#1b7837","conservative":"#7fbf7b","conservative (aromatic)":"#7fbf7b","not retained":"#d6604d"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.25,1]})
ax=axes[0]
y=np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
act=[r[3] for r in rows]
bars=ax.barh(y,[100 if np.isnan(a) else a for a in act],color=[colmap[r[4]] for r in rows],edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5)
for yy,r,a in zip(y,rows,act):
    lab=f"{r[0]} → {r[1]}"
    ax.text(-3,yy,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
    ax.text((100 if np.isnan(a) else a)+2,yy,("not mutated" if np.isnan(a) else f"{a:g}% WT"),va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(-38,135); ax.set_xlabel("DpaA alanine-mutant activity on PG-Lpp (% of wild type), Wang et al. 2023")
ax.set_title("PP_1451 residue at each experimentally tested DpaA position",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for yy,r in zip(y,rows): ax.text(118,yy,r[2][:34],fontsize=7.5,va="center",color="#444")
ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
ax.barh(y,dev,color=[colmap[r[4]] for r in rows],edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r[0]}/{r[1]}" for r in rows],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("C$\\alpha$ deviation after structural superposition (Å)")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold PP_1451 on DpaA 8IKR chain A\n126 aligned pairs, 1.56 Å RMSD over 118 core residues",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor="#1b7837",label="identical"),Patch(facecolor="#7fbf7b",label="conservative"),
                    Patch(facecolor="#d6604d",label="not retained")],loc="lower center",ncol=3,frameon=False,fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0.06,1,1])
plt.show()
